subject: Sparse, selectively monitored packages cannot clear an entire delivery, carrier, bay, or route.
rationale: The target establishes limited monitoring capacity, untracked package histories, and varied operating and receiving conditions. Findings from selected packages therefore lack a warranted bridge to blanket exoneration of any listed larger unit: unmonitored packages and occasions remain unresolved. This justifies the stated generalization limit without asserting that any unmonitored package actually experienced warming.
